subject: Similar tastes
author: SUFFUR
body:
I picked up, the new Nickelback album, Gwen Stafani, best of Deep Forrest, Limpkin Park, Beasty Boys, Mix it up, and something else, that even looking in my Resent Music, on my media player, i can't see what i got, becasue the newest stuff is what Drunk showed me and i lent the disk to a freind to check out. So i'll try and add it later. I also like most music, as diffirent moods, diffirent music, and meeting diffirent people would mean new music. I meet people who say have you heard this and end up buying the album, i did that with Deep Forrest, when i saw a friend in New York, in the early 90's, but the albums i did have got nicked, borrowed and forgotten to be returned, so that Best off was nice to pick up. But everything that Broken talked about, is stuff i own or have heard, so we seem to have the similar tastes. A cool story was going to Newcastle, with Drunk and him playing Green Day, all the way up and down, yes 12 hours of the Day. I liked the Day, but never bought an album of thiers, now i have a couple of them. Thanks Drunk.

I do have over a 1000 albums, on diffirent formats, from tape, record and CD and they range from Classical, to Ostrigic Tenticals and Phil Collins so all music can be good and i like it. Ok this stuff does not work, and does not make sense. But i like music, which is my final statement.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: Bands I Love
author: ZombieTron
body: There are only two bands that I Love. They Might Be Giants and The Presidents of the United States of America. But I like a whole load more, from Heavy Rock thru Grunge to Jazz fusion and more poptastic toons. I love going to gigs but it has been way too long since I was in a mosh pit. Moving away from London was great for most things except for live music! and I missed xfm for a while too. I really like the Burnout sound tracks, its good to know that the tracks were chosen by the guys at Criterion - they have good taste! 🙂
